independent_holdout.reason: No historical observations are claimed unseen; an independent dataset must be registered before a confirmatory run.

maturity_rule: first count sessions from origin for forecasts; account returns start at actual next-session execution; missing or immature outcomes remain explicitly unscored
forecast_target: arithmetic total return in USD including distributions; no mixing log and arithmetic forecasts

primary_tests.reference: training-only expanding mean of daily arithmetic total returns compounded as (1+mean_daily_return)**h-1; minimum 252 daily return intervals ending by origin, otherwise unscored
primary_tests.effect: reference_squared_error-minus-candidate_squared_error; equal weight to origins and equal weight to eligible instruments within origin

primary_tests.candidate: Spearman rank correlation of predicted and realized arithmetic total returns within each origin
primary_tests.reference: same-origin trailing filed EPS divided by same-basis origin price
primary_tests.effect: candidate_IC-minus-reference_IC on identical instrument intersection; ties use midranks; fewer than 10 instruments or constant scores unscored

primary_tests.candidate: sequential monthly full-engine account net of base costs
primary_tests.reference: SPY plus cash with risky weight clip(candidate ex-ante portfolio beta,0,1); beta fitted to trailing 252 sessions available at origin, minimum 126 aligned returns; same execution and cash accrual rules
primary_tests.effect: annualized mean paired monthly log-return differential; separate duration/credit exposures must be reported before any skill attribution

multiple_testing.family: seven primary tests above, three MSE plus three IC plus one economic
multiple_testing.rule: no omnibus pass by picking a successful horizon or metric; report all effects and intervals; retrospective results remain descriptive

uncertainty.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over origin months, resampling the entire cross-section jointly
uncertainty.one_sided_p: center the origin-effect series at zero; (1+count(null_bootstrap_mean >= observed_mean))/(draws+1)
uncertainty.minimum_origins: at least four blocks for each chosen length; otherwise insufficient-sample, no formal significance claim
uncertainty.overlap: do not count overlapping horizons, instruments, or Monte Carlo paths as independent replications

risk_diagnostics: sample CRPS of predictive total-return distribution
Brier score for probability of loss versus training-only loss frequency
p05 and p95 exceedance rates with joint month-block intervals
predicted variance versus realized sum of squared daily log returns
tail-loss and maximum-drawdown diagnostics with event counts; no tail validity claim from low power
secondary_benchmarks: equal weights in same causal eligible universe
same full engine with alpha set to zero
same full engine with unconditional training-only covariance

costs.stress: triple spread and slippage; base costs are an explicit scenario, not observed broker quotes
costs.dividends: actual cash flows and split-consistent shares, no double-counting adjusted prices plus cash dividends
costs.cash: realized documented cash accrual, never forecast cash yield as realized outcome

model_freeze.policy: hash engine source, data manifest, calibration, settings, search budgets, seeds and protocol before scoring; preserve every candidate version and cohort
model_freeze.production_entrypoint: composeMultiStart with referenceRequest; conditional risk recalibrated using only eligible past inputs
model_freeze.search: use reference settings and existing default search budgets, no selection by realized results
model_freeze.seed_policy: fixed ex-ante seeds; sensitivity changes are separate research versions

missing_data.no_eligible_only_full_period_account: gaps cannot silently become cash or skipped decisions; report blocked timeline, origin and instrument selection and reference coverage on the same sample

validation_decision: unestablished until predictive accuracy, risk calibration and net economic value have consistent out-of-sample evidence with uncertainty reported and prospective confirmation; software tests do not establish financial validity
